concept: Mistakes are part of learning, not proof that something is wrong with you
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.story: A short tale where a character makes a mistake, feels bad briefly, and then uses it to learn something for next time
exercise.reflection_prompt: What did the mistake teach the character?
exercise.practice: Student shares a mistake they made and one thing it taught them

assessment.success_marker: student names a specific lesson learned, not just the mistake itself
